skills.name: Writing about pollution as an enemy of the environment

note.text:
An essay on pollution: an introduction that defines pollution; one paragraph on types and causes; one on consequences; one on solutions; a conclusion.
Use relative clauses to add information (factories which pour waste into rivers), linking words (firstly, moreover, as a result, therefore) and vocabulary from the unit.

worked_example.problem: Plan an essay: “Pollution, an enemy of the environment”.
steps: Types and causes: air, water, land, noise.
Consequences: diseases, dead fish, poor soils.
Solutions: the three Rs, treating waste water, fewer plastic bags.

example: Pollution is the presence of harmful substances in the environment.

cards.idea: Use relative clauses to add information.
example: Factories which pour waste into rivers kill fish.

cards.idea: End with a call to act.
example: Therefore, each of us must reduce, reuse and recycle.

questions.prompt: Put the sentences of the essay in order.

items.text: Pollution is the presence of harmful substances in the environment.
Firstly, vehicles which are old release thick smoke.
As a result, many children suffer from coughs.
However, we can reduce pollution by recycling.
Therefore, each of us must act now.

paper_task.prompt: Write an essay of about 180 words in your exercise book: “Pollution, an enemy of the environment”.
model:
Pollution is the presence of harmful substances in the air, water or soil. It is an enemy which attacks our health and our environment.

There are several types of pollution. Firstly, old vehicles and generators release smoke which pollutes the air. Secondly, factories which pour waste into rivers pollute the water. Moreover, plastic bags which people throw away pollute the land, and loud music causes noise pollution.

As a result, many people suffer from coughs and asthma, while dirty water brings cholera. Fish die and soils become poor.

However, we can fight this enemy. We should reduce, reuse and recycle our waste, use fewer plastic bags and plant trees. Factories must treat their waste water.

Therefore, each of us must act now, because a clean environment means a healthy life.
checklist: I wrote about causes, consequences and solutions.
My conclusion calls people to act.
